judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid then receives a three-coin commission; bids also cannot exceed your coins. The model did not claim commission-before-payment enabling overbidding.

The claim that waiting reveals rival bids before you commit is incorrect here; the transcript shows the clerk revealing committed rival bids while the focal player was already committed. The model did not articulate the claimed mechanism of pre-commit revelation.

judgments.quote: Per the rules, all unresolved lots remain unsold at the eight-round horizon. The game is complete with all players at 12 coins and 0 owned value (three-way tie at 12 points each). I'll close to settle.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly links the eight-round horizon to unresolved lots remaining unsold and uses that to justify closing to settle the game despite unauctioned lots—this correctly articulates the terminal mechanism and ties it to the observed settlement.
The rules specify the three-coin commission is given to the auction winner; there is no evidence the model claimed catalog buys receive that commission.
